capabilities.why: getA11yFocusedParagraph() and LOK_CALLBACK_A11Y_FOCUS_CHANGED are the only source of paragraph identity in LOK (measured: LOK has no paragraph index anywhere).  Without this, every caret fingerprint is the hash of an empty string and finding 046's identity gate has no input -- not broken, unfed.

Opening an ODS needs the Calc document shell, the ODS importer, the document model and the LOK part/tile entry points.  A core built with --with-wasm-module=writer has none of them: the module's directories are not even in the build.  This asks whether the objects that ARE that capability exist, are linked, and are registered; it does not claim to have opened a spreadsheet.
